statement: SK Hynix's CEO indicated supply constraints for AI memory chips could persist through 2027.
why: If the largest HBM supplier expects tightness to last another year and a half, memory stays a binding limit on how many accelerators can actually ship.

impact.mechanism: Persistent AI memory shortage caps accelerator build rates and keeps memory pricing elevated, squeezing everyone who needs HBM to ship silicon.

evidence.excerpt: supply constraints for AI memory chips could persist through 2027

confidence.basis: CEO statement relayed as a quote or paraphrase by a single secondary outlet; forward-looking and hedged ('could persist').

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> flat); sources: StockTitan (SEC/6-K filing aggregator), ad-hoc-news.de
